questions.cardText:
[Economics] Which one of the following examples describes Gresham’s Law?
A. People keep rarer coins and spend more common coins
B. Low unemployment means high inflation
C. People tend to invest in gold during economic downturns
Answer: A. Gresham’s Law, or “bad money drives out good,” states that in a system where two forms of money are in circulation, the money perceived to be of lower value will be spent more widely, while the money perceived to be of higher value will be hoarded or removed from circulation.
questions.en: Which economic law, summed up as “bad money drives out good”, says that when two forms of money circulate, the one seen as less valuable is spent while the more valuable one is hoarded?
questions.de: Welches ökonomische Gesetz, zusammengefasst als „schlechtes Geld verdrängt gutes“, besagt, dass bei zwei umlaufenden Geldarten die als weniger wertvoll angesehene ausgegeben und die wertvollere gehortet wird?

timeline.labelEn: Sir Thomas Gresham, Tudor financier after whom Gresham's law is named
timeline.labelDe: Sir Thomas Gresham, Finanzier der Tudorzeit, nach dem das Greshamsche Gesetz benannt ist

questions.notes: Option A is only a loose illustration: the law is about the overvalued ('bad') money driving the undervalued ('good') money out of circulation, not rarity. Gresham's birth year is c. 1519 (died 21 Nov 1579). The name was given by Henry Dunning Macleod in 1857/1858 (Wikipedia gives both).

questions.cardText:
[Linguistics] What is the study of meaning in language known as?
A. Phonetics B. Semantics C. Syntax
Answer: B.
questions.en: What is the study of meaning in language called?
questions.de: Wie nennt man die Lehre von der Bedeutung in der Sprache?

timeline.labelEn: Michel Bréal introduces the French term “sémantique” (semantics) in his “Fragment de sémantique”
timeline.labelDe: Michel Bréal führt in seinem „Fragment de sémantique“ den französischen Begriff „sémantique“ (Semantik) ein

questions.notes: Bréal's 1883 article is cited on his Wikipedia page; his 'Essai de sémantique' followed in 1897.
